acceptanceCriteria: A regression with that request plans step 3 with goto.
Plans without unresolved steps are byte-identical before and after the fix.
body: Codex round-3 P2 on the gh660 lane (V1-0959, claude/gh660 e7349d77), reproduced on the gh657 fixture with the request "book a tee time; delete the club; check the slot status". Expected: step 2 is UNMAPPED, so step 3 navigates with goto. Actual: step 3 gets `stay`, assuming the session is still where step 1 left it. Fix near internal/appmap/plan.go:722: when a step resolves to no app, forget every session's position.
title: map_plan keeps a session's navigation position across a step that resolves to no app
